title: Voice providers declare their traits; failover and routes stop naming them
gates_note: tsc/api/unit are whole-tree exit codes, red ONLY on siblings' in-flight paths (listed in notes); on this card's paths tsc has 0 errors, api:check has no finding for either touched route, and every touched-directory suite passes. perf = base+my files alone after the raise.
deviations_from_card: (1) One commit carries tests+code (refactor) instead of test-then-feat: the test file imports the new provider-traits.ts, so a tests-only commit could not be green. Red-before measured instead: the 6 provider-traits cases fail at base (module absent) and the 2 new connect-failover cases (free-to-paid, three providers) were run against base 11ee55111's connect-failover.ts in a git-archive scratch copy and both failed (Missing expected rejection / OAI primary boom). (2) Outside the write set, as the brief's source-guard rule allows: app/api/intake/intake-refusal-guard.test.ts pinned the old literal `provider: "openai"` in the INTAKE_VOICE_NOT_CONFIGURED refusal; it now pins `provider: relayId` AND forbids a refusal without its need data. (3) perf-budget.json app/page.tsx maxModules 1443 -> 1444 under the lock (bb3edc4c2). (4) otherProvider deleted with its one test (card step 4 option); no external caller existed besides the index.ts re-export, also removed. (5) Extra exports relayFallbackProvider/relayCapableProviders so the 503 keeps naming the first relay-capable provider and its missing env byte-for-byte.
